stem:
Nitrogen monoxide, $\text{NO}$, reacts with oxygen to form nitrogen dioxide, $\text{NO}_2$.

$$2\text{NO(g)} + \text{O}_2\text{(g)} \rightleftharpoons 2\text{NO}_2\text{(g)}$$

The rate equation for the forward reaction is shown.

$$\text{rate} = k[\text{NO}]^2[\text{O}_2]$$

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Complete the following table.

| the order of reaction with respect to $[\text{NO}]$ |  |
| :--- | :--- |
| the order of reaction with respect to $[\text{O}_2]$ |  |
| the overall order of reaction |  |

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem:
Two separate experiments are carried out at $30^{\circ}\text{C}$ to determine the rate of the forward reaction.

| experiment | $[\text{NO}]/\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ | $[\text{O}_2]/\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ | $\text{rate}/\text{mol dm}^{-3}\text{s}^{-1}$ |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 1 | $0.00300$ | $0.00200$ | $1.51 \times 10^{-4}$ |
| 2 |  |  |  |
| $0.00500$ | $6.05 \times 10^{-5}$ |  |  |

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Use the data for experiment 1 to calculate the value of the rate constant, $k$. State the units of $k$.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Calculate the value of [NO] in experiment 2.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
Peroxodisulfate ions, $\text{S}_2\text{O}_8^{2-}$, react with iodide ions, $\text{I}^{-}$.

$$\text{S}_2\text{O}_8^{2-} + 2\text{I}^{-} \rightarrow 2\text{SO}_4^{2-} + \text{I}_2$$

The rate equation for the reaction in the absence of any catalyst is shown.

$$\text{rate} = k[\text{S}_2\text{O}_8^{2-}][\text{I}^{-}]$$

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.text: Suggest equations for a two-step mechanism for this reaction, stating which of the two steps is the rate-determining step.

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text:
A large excess of peroxodisulfate ions is mixed with iodide ions. Immediately after mixing, $[\text{I}^{-}] = 0.00780\,\text{mol dm}^{-3}$. Under the conditions used, the half-life of $[\text{I}^{-}]$ is 48 seconds.

Calculate the iodide ion concentration 192 seconds after the peroxodisulfate and iodide ions are mixed.
